tldr: Mercury in the 12th house: thinking becomes personal through rest, solitude, hidden pressure, dreams, retreat, endings, and the inner life.
body:
With Mercury in the 12th house, this part of you works through rest, solitude, hidden pressure, dreams, retreat, endings, and the inner life. Mercury describes thinking, communication, learning, writing, and the way the mind makes connections. In practice, this brings attention to what happens behind the scenes, including fatigue, private processing, unfinished feelings, and the need to step back.

When this placement is supported, you can make room for what needs quiet, closure, or a softer pace. Mercury can become clear language, strategy, curiosity, problem-solving, and the ability to name what is happening.

When it is strained, avoidance can look like rest, and silence can start carrying more than it should. The harder pattern can show up as overthinking, nervous loops, clever avoidance, or talking around what needs to be said.
gift: clear language, strategy, curiosity, problem-solving, and the ability to name what is happening expressed through rest, solitude, hidden pressure, dreams, retreat, endings, and the inner life.
challenge: overthinking, nervous loops, clever avoidance, or talking around what needs to be said around rest, solitude, hidden pressure, dreams, retreat, endings, and the inner life.
